kitDescription: Yulha is a Fire SR Burst-III attacker whose kit revolves around a 'Calm' self-status earned by being attacked 30 times. The S1 attacked-30× self Critical Rate ▲24.53%/20s line is now encoded, but it is inert at scope lock because the boss never attacks. Her unconditional lines fire regardless: Skill 2 raises ALL allies' ATK by 90.75% for 5s every 30s, and her burst deals 457.87% of final ATK to all enemies. The Calm-gated half of her kit — the Calm self-status and the burst's additional 457.87% rider — remains unmodeled (out-of-domain), as does Skill 2's damage-sharing clause (defensive).
caveats: skill1: the attacked-30× self Critical Rate ▲24.53%/20s line is now ENCODED using the attacked-count trigger; it is inert at scope lock because the boss never attacks. The Calm self-status itself remains unmodeled, so the Calm-gated burst rider is still unreachable
burst: the 'when in Calm status → 457.87% additional damage' rider is UNMODELED — it is gated on the untriggerable Calm self-status, so the burst fires at half its theoretical (Calm-active) magnitude
skill2: 'Equally shares damage taken for 10 sec' is UNMODELED — defensive damage redistribution; the boss deals no damage and there is no redistribution primitive
skill1/skill2/burst: SR cadence tuple (charge 60f / reload 133f / bolt gap) is an unmeasured datamine estimate
